# `csharp_max_formal_parameters_on_line`

Chop a parameter list carrying more than this many parameters, regardless of width.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `(not set)`

## Example

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```ini
csharp_max_formal_parameters_on_line = <value>
```
